title: Create credits feature structure with service and queries
description: Set up features/credits/ with service for balance operations
design: features/credits/: services/credits.service.ts (getUserCredits, addCredits, deductCredit, refundCredit), queries/credits.query.ts (createAuthenticatedQuery for balance), models/credits.model.ts (types), index.ts. Follow subscription feature patterns. Use prisma transactions for atomicity.

title: Create Credits purchase page at /credits
description: Page with balance display and buy button
design: app/(protected)/credits/page.tsx: Auth required. Display current balance prominently. Credit pack card with title, price, per-image cost. Buy button triggers Polar checkout (use @polar-sh/checkout or redirect). Success redirects to /credits/success. Follow existing protected page patterns.

title: Add webhook handler for Polar order.completed event
description: Handle credit purchase webhook to add credits
design: app/api/webhooks/polar/route.ts or similar. Verify signature, parse order.completed event, extract userId from customer.externalId, credits from product metadata. Call addCredits(userId, 10). Idempotent: check referenceId before adding. Log with logger.

title: Create PR for usage-based-pricing feature
description: Open PR to merge feat/usage-based-pricing into main
design: gh pr create with summary of all changes, test plan covering: purchase flow, balance display, deduction, refund, blocked state

title: Usage-Based Pricing: Prepaid credit system for image generation
description: Implement prepaid credit system via Polar. See specs/usage-based-pricing.md

title: Add UserCredits and CreditTransaction models to Prisma schema
description: Add credit balance and transaction history tables
design: prisma/schema.prisma: Add UserCredits (userId, balance, updatedAt) with 1:1 User relation. Add CreditTransaction (id, userId, type enum, amount, referenceId, createdAt). type enum: purchase|usage|refund. Follow existing Subscription model patterns.

title: Run database migration for credits tables
design: pnpm db:migrate after schema changes. Migration name: add_credits_system

title: Configure Polar product for 10-credit pack
description: Create product in Polar dashboard for credit pack
design: Polar dashboard: Create one-time product '10 Credits - $5', price 500 cents. Add product ID to env config and products.generated.ts. Set metadata.credits=10

title: Create GenerationBlocked component for zero credits
description: UI shown when user has 0 credits and tries to generate
design: features/credits/components/generation-blocked.tsx: Message 'You're out of credits', current balance (0), Buy Credits CTA linking to routes.credits. Used in generation UI when balance check fails.

title: Add credits feature to NavAccount and NavMobile
design: components/navbar/nav-account.tsx: Import CreditBalance, render before dashboard button (only when session exists). components/navbar/nav-account-mobile.tsx: Same integration for mobile nav.

title: Add credits locales to locales/index.ts
description: Add i18n strings for credits feature
design: locales/index.ts: Add CreditsPage (metadata, balance label, pack title, price, buy button), CreditBalance (label, zero warning), NavAccount.creditsLabel. Follow existing locale patterns.

title: Implement auto-refund on failed generation
description: Refund credit when image generation API fails
design: features/credits/services/credits.service.ts: refundCredit(userId, generationId) - add 1 credit, create transaction type=refund. Call in generation error handler. Idempotent via referenceId check.

title: Create CreditBalance component for navbar
description: Display credit balance in header, clickable to credits page
design: features/credits/components/credit-balance.tsx: Client component, useQuery for balance. States: loading (skeleton), has credits (icon + number), zero (warning style). Icon: Coins from lucide-react. Link to routes.credits. Add to NavAccount between dashboard button and avatar.

title: Create feature branch feat/usage-based-pricing
description: Create and checkout feature branch from main

title: Implement credit deduction logic for generation
description: Deduct 1 credit when user generates image
design: features/credits/services/credits.service.ts: deductCredit(userId, generationId) - atomic check balance >= 1, deduct, create transaction type=usage. Return success/insufficient. Called before generation API call. If generation fails later, call refundCredit.

title: Add routes.credits to config/routes.ts
design: config/routes.ts: Add credits: '/credits' under routes object

title: Create Credits success page at /credits/success
design: app/(protected)/credits/success/page.tsx: Success message, new balance display (fetch fresh), CTA to generation page. Trigger balance sync from Polar on mount if needed.
